select_accuracy_cases: select accuracy test cases by filtering a list of DiffusionTestCase objects against enabled case IDs
get_accuracy_one_gpu_case_ids: get the tuple of case IDs for one-GPU accuracy test cases including qwen_image_t2i and flux models
get_accuracy_two_gpu_case_ids: get the tuple of case IDs for two-GPU accuracy test cases including wan2_2 and fsdp-inference
get_accuracy_one_gpu_cases: get the filtered list of DiffusionTestCase objects for one-GPU accuracy testing
get_accuracy_two_gpu_cases: get the filtered list of DiffusionTestCase objects for two-GPU accuracy testing
